single_changed_mechanism.hypothesis: A commercially art-directed forest-edge still-life arranged as one believable basket placement with natural partial occlusion and unified incidental light will look less catalog-staged than the prior ingredient-list scene.
photographic_grammar: Vertical portrait, low three-quarter view (near basket-rim eye level), basket concentrated in middle/lower frame and visually integrated with shaded fern/moss background
One large Chinese napa cabbage, two Chinese daikon radishes, a few red/green long chilies; main produce partly masks each other and can extend beyond basket edge rather than lining up
Believable staging: produce harvested from nearby farmland, basket rested by forest edge for an intentional food editorial photograph; do not imply vegetables naturally grow in wild mossy forest
Single soft woodland-side natural light source; a real gradient and occlusion/shadow across materials, without each vegetable separately beautified

Distinct material optics: cabbage leaves translucent/dry and irregular, radish relatively matte with minor adhering field soil, chilies naturally waxy, woven basket mostly dry; not identical droplets/patina everywhere
Natural environmental depth; upper background dark green foliage and ferns in partial focus/occlusion; no need for all foliage or all food to be crisply legible
Retain richness and appetizing beauty as in source commercial reference, but not a supermarket-like ingredient checklist
hard_content_avoids: No poster typography, logo, stamps, signatures or watermark
No unrequested mushrooms, tomatoes, bell peppers, cucumbers, garlic or potatoes
No extra unrelated ornaments or artificial hero spotlight

one_image_generation_direction_zh: 以本次唯一附带的森林菌菇摄影参考为摄影语言，创作一张全新的无字9:16竖幅真实食材静物：林缘阴凉处，一只低矮手编竹篮刚被放在带苔藓的石旁，篮中主要是一棵大白菜、两根白萝卜和少量红绿长辣椒。镜头从篮沿附近斜向观察，竹篮位于画面中下部，叶片与萝卜自然交错遮挡，部分物体不必完整展示。柔和林间侧光只照亮局部，蔬菜、竹编、苔藓保留彼此不同的干湿与表面质感，后景是幽暗蕨叶和自然层次。不要任何文字、标志、其他品种蔬菜；不要把食材逐件陈列。原创布局，不复制参考照片的具体布置。
